cases.plan_item: BUG-proof wave 1, group P (ERASE and OOPS); BUG-285
cases.expected: After SETUP-R47v, select the new pipe from P8 and type ERASE: the pipe, its label, its two IL texts and its flow arrow go (1040 -> 1035; only the pit P8 is left of the six new objects). Type OOPS: all five come back (1040; one label on 25TEXT, two IL texts on 20TEXT, one arrow on ARROW) and the command line says '[CE] OOPS brought back pipe from P8 with its ..., and re-linked it.' (one such line). Then select P8 and MOVE it 1000 mm down: the pipe's P8 end follows (its box lower-left y goes below -80500).

not_automated: The exact nouns of the item list in the OOPS line (see the comment above); recorded only.
Whether the label and IL texts sit where they were before the erase is not measured; only that each came back on its layer.

cases.expected: Draw one new pipe with CD (150000,-90000 to 170000,-90000, 18.000 / 17.800). Select it together with the older pipe P4 -> P3 (10A98D) and type CDEDIT. Opening the batch editor for the other pipe.' The batch editor opens titled 'Edit Pipe' (not 'Edit 1 Pipes') with 'Apply to Selected' and 'Carry downstream'.
